DeviceSessionContent.title: DeviceSessionContent
DeviceSessionContent.description: The content of a device-session record: discriminator, version, tenant scope, W011 device descriptor, optional virtual-time schedule, lifecycle state, and consistent frame/tick/mount state.

ExperienceRuntimeProtocolVersion.title: ExperienceRuntimeProtocolVersion
ExperienceRuntimeProtocolVersion.description: Exact experience-runtime protocol version admitted by this release ("1.0.0").

DeviceSessionId.title: DeviceSessionId
DeviceSessionId.description: Device-session identifier: "ds-" followed by a lowercase slug.

TenantScope.title: TenantScope
TenantScope.description: Tenant scoping of an experience document: owning tenant, optional workspace and project narrowing.

OpaqueScopeId.title: OpaqueScopeId
OpaqueScopeId.description: Opaque scoping identifier (tenant/workspace/project/participant); bounded, neutral charset.

DeviceDescriptor.title: DeviceDescriptor
DeviceDescriptor.description: Abstract, provider-neutral device descriptor: capabilities and budgets as typed data; filled/adapted by renderer/device adaptation (W019).

DeviceClass.title: DeviceClass
DeviceClass.description: Neutral device class of a device descriptor (never a vendor product).

InteractionModality.title: InteractionModality
InteractionModality.description: Neutral interaction modality of a device.

DeviceDisplayCapabilities.title: DeviceDisplayCapabilities
DeviceDisplayCapabilities.description: Neutral display capabilities and budgets of a device descriptor.

DeviceSpatialCapabilities.title: DeviceSpatialCapabilities
DeviceSpatialCapabilities.description: Neutral spatial capabilities and budgets of a device descriptor.

PoseTrackingKind.title: PoseTrackingKind
PoseTrackingKind.description: Neutral pose-tracking capability of a device.

FrameSchedule.title: FrameSchedule
FrameSchedule.description: Deterministic virtual-time frame/tick schedule: integer frame duration plus integer tick cadence (frames per tick).

DeviceSessionState.title: DeviceSessionState
DeviceSessionState.description: Lifecycle state of a device session: active, paused, or closed (terminal).

VirtualTimeMs.title: VirtualTimeMs
VirtualTimeMs.description: Virtual time in non-negative integer milliseconds since the session origin.

FrameIndex.title: FrameIndex
FrameIndex.description: 0-based index of a frame within a scheduled device session.

TickIndex.title: TickIndex
TickIndex.description: 0-based index of a tick within a scheduled device session.

EventSequence.title: EventSequence
EventSequence.description: 1-based contiguous per-session sequence number of a runtime event.
